entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6713727061309245952: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95347: distance 55.741 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.012), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 55.741 +/- 0.669 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 18.1088 +/- 0.2890 mas (same row, RUWE 2.86), 62.7 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 31.790, -120.087 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 6713727061309245952 (quality C), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 2.472 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95347: radius 2.472 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 122.118 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.431) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 12212 +/- 3038 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95347: effective temperature 12212 +/- 3038 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.02).
